features.name: v1_zscore
features.description: Standardized V1 (recency) using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance contribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes feature scale so KNN distances are not dominated by V3.

features.name: v2_zscore
features.description: Standardized V2 (frequency) using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Puts frequency on a comparable scale for neighborhood geometry.

features.name: v3_log_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed V3 (monetary) then standardized to reduce skew before distance computation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents large monetary values from dominating Euclidean distance.

features.name: v4_zscore
features.expected_model_benefit: Balances tenure feature scale within distance metric.

features.name: avg_volume_per_donation
features.description: Average monetary volume per donation event (V3 / V2), a stable per-row ratio.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures donation magnitude consistency, useful for similarity grouping.

features.name: donation_rate_per_month
features.description: Donations per month of tenure (V2 / V4), normalized engagement rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes donor engagement intensity into geometry.

features.name: active_tenure_ratio
features.description: Fraction of tenure since last donation, V1 / V4, measuring inactivity proportion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates lapsed vs active donors in neighborhood space.

features.name: recency_to_frequency_ratio
features.description: V1 divided by V2, time since last donation relative to total count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights donors whose recency is high relative to frequency.

features.name: distance_to_median_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance in standardized space to a generic central (median-like) prototype at origin.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct distance signal to dataset centroid aids KNN ranking.

features.name: distance_to_low_activity_prototype
features.description: Standardized Euclidean distance to an unsupervised low-activity prototype (high recency, low frequency, low monetary, short tenure).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides geometric anchor distinguishing infrequent donors.

features.name: distance_to_high_activity_prototype
features.description: Standardized Euclidean distance to an unsupervised high-activity prototype (low recency, high frequency, high monetary, long tenure).
features.expected_model_benefit: Anchors active donors as a distinct cluster in distance space.

features.name: donor_engagement_quality
features.description: Semantic ordinal score (0=dormant, 1=occasional, 2=regular, 3=committed) inferred from joint pattern of recency, frequency, and tenure indicators in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Cluster-like indicator that sharpens KNN neighborhood boundaries between behavioral regimes.
